field_schema.source_rule: Every field inherits the enclosing source address unless it has its own source. A memory offset identifies an object field, not a wire offset.
field_schema.order_rule: Field arrays are in wire order. body_offset starts after the command. For fragmented replies, logical offsets exclude the i metadata field.
field_schema.type_rule: code gives the codec type. width_bytes gives fixed scalar width. size gives variable encoded size. Scalars are little-endian raw bits unless signed use is stated. C includes a two-byte repeat count; semicolons emit no bytes.
field_schema.s: 2-byte UTF-16 code-unit count, then 2*N bytes, without a wire NUL

totals.definition: Full covers the handler receive layout and its immediate or checked link reply layout, with field meanings and codec widths. It does not certify downstream job behavior or all DB operations. Partial includes unchecked field meanings, nested layouts or reply paths.

link_setup.fact: Listener uses internal port ID 5, daemon manager +2024, config port field +192. Port ID 5 is not the TCP port value.
Registry loads clusters, then worlds. Worlds must fit configured ID range and refer to an existing cluster. Hello attaches to a preloaded world.
Hello checks packet version 80 and configured peer identity. It creates a 48-byte world-indexed TransactionChannel. It does not set the live flag.
link_setup.guide_difference: 348 version 83; do not use it for 307.

link_setup.fact: ServiceOpenNotify checks cluster/world and sets world +120 to 1. Duplicate live closes the world channel.
Channel add/remove/acquire use a critical section and world-ID-indexed slots. Add/acquire retain references; remove releases the table reference.
OnAccept returns true. OnConnect rejects outbound connections.
Close removes channel, clears world live flag and starts logout cleanup for sessions in that world.
Session lookup selects the per-world character-ID tree under a lock and retains the returned session.
Dispatcher accepts commands 1..109. Table entries are 16 bytes. Flags +8/+9 select channel-required/fragment behavior. Only 1 and 4 do not require a channel. All 51 fragment flags are false.
For channel handlers, dispatcher does not propagate the handler return value. Hello and ServiceOpen return values use the direct session path.

codec.status: ✅ basic encoding; ❓ complete message semantics and iterator receive paths
codec.s: Two-byte nonnegative UTF-16 code-unit count, then that many UTF-16LE code units. No NUL is sent. Decoder appends NUL in destination and requires capacity >= count+1.
codec.b: Two-byte byte length followed by bytes. Decoder rejects a negative signed-16 length. Full destination-capacity/error handling not expanded here.
codec.repeat: C opens a two-byte count; repeated fields run to matching ;. ; itself writes no bytes in basic codec.
codec.signedness: Scalar code copies raw bits. Interpret signed values only when the handler establishes their meaning.
